Our return policy is all about timing and condition:

When: Items must be posted back on the last day of your rental using tracked next‑day delivery; late returns can incur late fees.
Condition: Return items in the same condition you received them—no new damage, stains, or alterations.
Problems:
If an item arrives late or in poor condition, report it in‑app immediately, return it within 24 hours, and request a refund via the Rental page.
Refunds generally cover the rental cost only (service fees, postage, and cleaning are usually non‑refundable) and are often issued as app credit, especially for fit issues.

In short: send back on time, via tracked next‑day postage, and in original condition; if something’s wrong, document it, communicate quickly in‑app, and submit a refund request within the required windows.
